name: bifrost
description: Bifrost AI Gateway — Heroku buildpack deploy (apt + Node UI + Go transport)

PROJECT_PATH.description: Subdirectory containing go.mod (required by subdir buildpack)

GO_INSTALL_PACKAGE_SPEC.description: Go package to build after PROJECT_PATH is promoted to app root

NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION.description: Install UI devDependencies (vite, typescript) needed for heroku-postbuild

BIFROST_HOST.description: Bind address for the HTTP server

APP_DIR.description: Writable data directory for config.db / logs (ephemeral on Heroku dynos)

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logger level: debug, info, warn, error

LOG_STYLE.description: Logger output style: json or pretty
